movies.title: Back to the Future
movies.description: Marty McFly is accidentally sent from 1985 to 1955 in Doc Brown’s DeLorean, where he disrupts the meeting that made his parents fall in love. To save his own existence, Marty must repair their relationship and find a way back home.

movies.title: Back to the Future II
movies.description: Marty McFly and Doc Brown travel to 2015 to protect Marty’s future family, but Biff Tannen steals an idea that rewrites 1985 into a nightmare. Marty and Doc must untangle the altered timeline without undoing the history they already repaired.

movies.title: Back to the Future III
movies.description: After Doc Brown becomes stranded in 1885, Marty McFly travels to the Old West to bring him home before Buford ‘Mad Dog’ Tannen kills him. Their escape grows harder when Doc falls for schoolteacher Clara Clayton.

movies.title: 500 Days of Summer
movies.description: Greeting-card writer Tom Hansen falls for his coworker Summer Finn, who is clear that she does not believe in lasting love. Told out of order across 500 days, their relationship exposes the gap between Tom’s romantic ideal and what Summer actually promised him.

movies.title: 2010: The Year We Make Contact
movies.description: Dr. Heywood Floyd joins a Soviet mission to Jupiter to board the abandoned Discovery, reactivate HAL 9000 and learn what happened to Dave Bowman nine years earlier. As U.S.-Soviet tensions rise on Earth, the mission encounters a transformation around Jupiter that makes their politics suddenly very small.

movies.title: A '90s Christmas
movies.description: Workaholic lawyer Lucy Miller celebrates a promotion alone on Christmas Eve when a mysterious rideshare sends her back to Christmas 1999. Reunited with her family, best friend Grace and high-school love Matt, Lucy gets a chance to see exactly how the relationships in her present were lost.

movies.title: A Biltmore Christmas
movies.description: Screenwriter Lucy Hardgrove is sent to the Biltmore Estate while rewriting a remake of the 1947 Christmas classic His Merry Wife! An antique hourglass carries her onto the original film set, where she meets star Jack Huston and risks changing the movie, and her own future.

movies.title: A Bird of the Air
movies.description: Night-shift highway worker Lyman lives almost entirely alone until a stray talking parrot lands in his trailer. Fiona, an impulsive librarian, persuades him to trace the bird’s cryptic phrases back to its owner, pulling Lyman into other people’s lives and toward the history he avoids.

movies.title: A Bride for Christmas
movies.description: Jessie Patterson calls off her third engagement at the altar and swears she will marry only when she is certain. Meanwhile, chronic bachelor Aiden MacTiernan bets his friends he can get a woman to accept a proposal by Christmas, and unknowingly chooses Jessie as his target.

movies.title: A Little Romance
movies.description: Bookish American Lauren King and movie-loving Parisian Daniel Michon, both 13, fall in love in Paris. When Lauren learns she must return to America, eccentric elderly Julius Santorin helps them escape toward Venice to test a legend about a kiss beneath the Bridge of Sighs.

movies.title: A Picture of Her
movies.description: Beth, a first mate on her father’s salmon boat, visits Los Angeles and unknowingly becomes the subject of photographer Jake Driver’s candid shot at a flower market. The image becomes a magazine-cover sensation just as Beth begins getting close to Jake without knowing he took it.

movies.title: Alien
movies.description: The crew of the commercial starship Nostromo diverts to investigate a signal from an unknown moon. After Kane is brought back aboard with a strange organism attached to him, warrant officer Ellen Ripley and the remaining crew discover they are trapped in deep space with a rapidly growing predator.

movies.title: Aliens
movies.description: Fifty-seven years after escaping the Nostromo, Ellen Ripley learns that families have settled the moon where her crew found the alien eggs. When contact with the colony is lost, she returns with Colonial Marines and finds young survivor Newt amid a far larger infestation.

movies.title: An Hour Behind
movies.description: Pastry chef Trish Harper forgets the daylight-saving time change and arrives an hour late for a blind date, where she mistakes paramedic Parker for the man her sister chose. The accidental date works far better than the planned one, but Parker carries a private loss Trish does not yet understand.

movies.title: An Unfinished Life
movies.description: Jean Gilkyson flees an abusive boyfriend with her daughter Griff and seeks refuge at the Wyoming ranch of her estranged father-in-law, Einar. Einar still blames Jean for his son’s death, while his injured friend Mitch quietly pushes the household toward forgiveness.

movies.title: Arachnophobia
movies.description: Dr. Ross Jennings moves his family from San Francisco to the small town of Canaima, hoping to build a quieter medical practice despite his lifelong fear of spiders. Then a lethal Venezuelan spider arrives hidden in a coffin, breeds near his new home and leaves deaths no one else can explain.

movies.title: Arn I: Tempelriddaren
movies.description: Arn Magnusson is raised by Cistercian monks and trained as a warrior before returning to a Sweden divided by rival dynasties. His love for Cecilia Algotsdotter and loyalty to Knut Eriksson bring church punishment that sends Arn to serve as a Knight Templar in the Holy Land.

movies.title: Arn II: Riket Vid Vägens Slut
movies.description: After years as a Templar commander in the Holy Land, Arn Magnusson survives the Crusaders’ defeat and is finally allowed to return to Sweden. Reunited with Cecilia, he builds a new life at Forsvik, only to be drawn into the struggle that will decide Sweden’s future.

movies.title: Batman Begins
movies.description: After years abroad confronting the criminal world, Bruce Wayne returns to Gotham and creates Batman with help from Alfred Pennyworth and Lucius Fox. As Dr. Jonathan Crane spreads a fear toxin through the city, Bruce discovers that Henri Ducard and the League of Shadows have a larger plan for Gotham.

movies.title: Beauty and the Beast
movies.description: Belle offers herself in place of her father Maurice at an enchanted castle ruled by a Beast. While Gaston schemes to make Belle his wife, she befriends Lumière, Cogsworth and Mrs. Potts and begins to see the lonely man beneath the Beast’s curse.

movies.title: Before I Fall
movies.description: Samantha Kingston dies after a party and wakes to relive February 12 again and again. Repeating the same day forces her to reconsider Lindsay, Rob, Kent and the group’s treatment of Juliet Sykes as she searches for the choice that can change what happens.

movies.title: Big
movies.description: Twelve-year-old Josh Baskin makes a wish at a Zoltar machine and wakes in the body of an adult. With his friend Billy searching for the machine, Josh finds work at MacMillan Toy Company, wins the trust of owner MacMillan and becomes close to coworker Susan Lawrence while trying to get his childhood back.

movies.title: Blame It on Rio
movies.description: Matthew Hollis vacations in Rio with his friend Victor Lyons and their daughters Nicole and Jennifer. Matthew begins a secret affair with Jennifer, while an unsuspecting Victor becomes obsessed with finding the older man involved with his daughter.

movies.title: Bring It On
movies.description: New Toros captain Torrance Shipman learns that the squad’s championship routines were stolen from Isis and the East Compton Clovers. With newcomer Missy Pantone, Torrance has to build an original routine before nationals while the Clovers fight for the recognition they were denied.

movies.title: Can't Buy My Love
movies.description: EMT Lilly is focused on her job and getting into medical school when wealthy, directionless Jeff enters her life. After Lilly rejects his entitlement, Jeff starts riding along on ambulance calls and their time together pushes both of them to look beyond their first assumptions.

movies.title: Can't Hardly Wait
movies.description: At the class graduation party, Preston Meyers plans to finally tell Amanda Beckett how he feels after her breakup with Mike Dexter. Around them, Kenny Fisher chases a hookup, Denise Fleming gets pulled into his plans and the night turns into a last collision of high-school reputations and unfinished business.

movies.title: Cars
movies.description: Rookie race car Lightning McQueen gets stranded in Radiator Springs while traveling to a Piston Cup tiebreaker. Forced to repair the town’s road under Doc Hudson’s watch, Lightning befriends Sally and Mater and discovers that winning is not the only thing worth chasing.

movies.title: Casanova
movies.description: In Venice, Giacomo Casanova becomes fascinated by outspoken Francesca Bruni, one woman unimpressed by his reputation. Pursuing her while hiding behind false identities draws him into conflict with Bishop Pucci, Francesca’s intended husband Paprizzio and the consequences of his own habits.

movies.title: Chances Are
movies.description: Louie Jeffries dies shortly after marrying Corinne and is reincarnated as Alex Finch. Twenty years later Alex meets Louie’s daughter Miranda and begins recovering memories of his former life, bringing him back into Corinne’s home and into the orbit of Louie’s best friend Philip.

movies.title: Chaos Theory
movies.description: Time-management lecturer Frank Allen lives by a rigid schedule until his wife Susan changes his clock and one missed ferry starts unraveling his routine. A shocking medical discovery then drives Frank to reject planning altogether and test how much of life can be left to chance.

movies.title: Charlie's Angels
movies.description: Charlie Townsend sends Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett to wine country to learn what happened to Vincent Le Mer before he is declared legally dead and his estate is divided. The Angels go undercover among the competing heirs while Bosley and Scott Woodville support the investigation.

movies.title: Christmas with Holly
movies.description: After six-year-old Holly stops speaking following her mother’s death, her uncle Mark Nagle moves with her to Friday Harbor to live with his brothers Alex and Scott. Newcomer Maggie Conway opens a toy shop nearby and gradually connects with Holly and Mark as Christmas approaches.

movies.title: Christmas with the Knightlys
movies.description: Schoolteacher Georgia Jackson wants to save her students’ Christmas showcase and secure a new community center. When the press mistakes her for billionaire heir Chase Knightly’s girlfriend, Georgia agrees to continue the fake relationship in exchange for his family’s support, only for the arrangement to become less artificial.

movies.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
movies.description: Cal Weaver’s marriage collapses when Emily asks for a divorce, leaving him adrift until smooth bachelor Jacob Palmer decides to rebuild his dating life. Jacob then unexpectedly falls for Hannah, while Cal’s son Robbie pursues Jessica, tying several seemingly separate romances back into the same family.

movies.title: Crusoe
movies.description: Years after being shipwrecked, Robinson Crusoe survives on a tropical island with his friend Friday while holding onto memories of his wife Susannah. When armed outsiders arrive, Crusoe and Friday are drawn into a new fight over the island and another fragile possibility of getting Crusoe home.

movies.title: Dangerous Beauty
movies.description: In 16th-century Venice, Veronica Franco is denied marriage to Marco Venier because of class and money, then trained by her mother Paola to become a courtesan. Her wit and influence make her famous, but war, jealousy and an Inquisition for witchcraft threaten the life she built.

movies.title: Dark Water
movies.description: After separating from Kyle, Dahlia Williams moves with her daughter Ceci into a decaying Roosevelt Island apartment. A spreading ceiling leak and the mystery of a missing girl turn their new home into something far more threatening than either expected.

movies.title: Dashing Home for Christmas
movies.description: Holiday travel chaos leaves business consultant Emily stranded on her way home for Christmas. With flights and plans collapsing around her, she reluctantly teams up with Simon, and the trip becomes less about getting there quickly than about who she is travelling with.

movies.title: Deja Vu
movies.description: ATF agent Doug Carlin investigates a deadly New Orleans ferry bombing and is brought into a secret program that can observe events four days in the past. When victim Claire Kuchever becomes central to the case, Doug begins looking for a way to do more than merely watch what happened.

movies.title: Desk Set
movies.description: Reference librarian Bunny Watson runs a remarkably efficient research department at a television network until efficiency expert Richard Sumner arrives to install a new computer. The staff fears the machine is meant to replace them while Bunny and Richard steadily test each other’s assumptions.

movies.title: Dragonheart
movies.description: Disillusioned knight Bowen teams with Draco, the last dragon, to stage profitable fake dragon slayings. Their partnership changes when Bowen learns Draco’s life is mystically tied to the cruel King Einon, forcing knight and dragon to decide what their friendship is worth.

movies.title: Easy A
movies.description: A private joke about Olive Penderghast’s weekend is overheard and spreads through school as fact. Rather than fight the rumor immediately, Olive experiments with the reputation it gives her, only to discover how quickly other people’s lies and needs can take control of her identity.

movies.title: Farmer Seeking Love
movies.description: Reality producer Claire Bardoz recruits farmer Joe Bennett to become the bachelor on a new dating show. As Claire shapes Joe’s televised search for love, working closely with him makes the distinction between producing a romance and becoming part of one increasingly difficult.

movies.title: Finding Christmas
movies.description: Sean Tucker and Owen Harrison swap homes for Christmas after separate disappointments send both men looking for a change. Sean meets Owen’s sister Ryan in North Carolina while Owen grows close to Sean’s assistant Mia in New York, giving both households an unexpected holiday reset.

movies.title: Finding Neverland
movies.description: Playwright J.M. Barrie befriends widow Sylvia Llewelyn Davies and her sons while struggling with his next work. His growing bond with the family, especially Peter, feeds the imagination that becomes Peter Pan while bringing pressure from both society and his own marriage.

movies.title: Flight of the Navigator
movies.description: Twelve-year-old David Freeman disappears in 1978 and returns eight years later without having aged. When NASA links him to a mysterious spacecraft, David discovers that the ship knows exactly where he has been and may be his only chance to recover the life he lost.

movies.title: Flyboys
movies.description: Before the United States enters World War I, Blaine Rawlings and other American volunteers join France’s Lafayette Escadrille. Training under Captain Thenault turns quickly into lethal aerial combat as the young pilots learn what courage, friendship and survival actually cost.

movies.title: French Kiss
movies.description: Kate flies to France to win back her fiancé Charlie despite a fear of flying, then becomes entangled with charming thief Luc Teyssier, who secretly uses her luggage to move stolen property. Their trip across France steadily complicates both Kate’s original plan and Luc’s.

movies.title: Gojira Mainasu Wan
movies.description: After surviving the war, former kamikaze pilot Koichi Shikishima tries to rebuild a life in devastated Japan with Noriko Oishi and the orphaned Akiko. His unresolved guilt becomes inseparable from a new national catastrophe when Godzilla emerges and leaves ordinary survivors to fight back.

movies.title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
movies.description: Joanna Drayton returns home unexpectedly with Dr. John Prentice and announces that they intend to marry. Her liberal parents Matt and Christina must decide whether the principles they have always professed still hold when an interracial marriage becomes an immediate family decision.

movies.title: The Man from Earth
movies.description: University professor John Oldman abruptly resigns and gathers colleagues at his cabin before leaving town. Pressed to explain himself, he claims he has lived continuously since prehistoric times, turning an informal farewell into an increasingly serious examination of history, belief and whether such a story could be disproved.
